lines: Luna skillfully operated 『Artemis』, the weapon mounted on her back, and aimed precisely at the leech's real body with its laser.
Before the laser could shoot through its real body, it was skillfully refracted by the water the leech controlled, and lost its power.
『Hahahaha!! The demon leech race are mighty!!! Tiny giants, that's what we are!!!』
「Master, the laser is twisting. And the enemy's personality is twisted as well.」
「Looks like it. Luna, do you have any other means of attack?!」
She spaced out for a moment.
（Dammit. Luna's...... Or rather, Artemis's main attack is lasers, huh?）
If that was the case, then an enemy that manipulated water was the worst possible combination.
But having said that, there was no other way.
（If I could just do something about the water......）
I was thinking things like that, when Asuka appeared, falling softly from the sky.
「I defeated most of the enemy troops!!」
I pointed at the demonic beast, which was swaying its body and laughing.
「Luna's lasers are accurate, but they're blocked by the water and can't hit it well enough.」
「Which mean we have to pry it away from the water somehow, right?」
「Mmm? Did something come to you, Fuuma?! I've been waiting for that face of yours!」
I swiftly cobbled together the ideas that had come to mind into a strategy.
「I want to borrow Asuka's strength. You're the most compatible with that bug.」
「What's that supposed to mean?! I'm not happy about that!」
『Keheehee! What's wrong, what's wrong? Don't get full of yourself just 'cause you took down a yakuza squad, y'know?』
『Before the invincible demon leech race, those guys are like powerless worms!!』
The leech bastard was still laughing it up on its own, and occasionally making “straight man” quips to itself.
I quickly explained the plan to Asuka and Luna.
「Roger. No objections. But we'll only have one chance!」
The first one to step up was Luna.
She activated all four Artemis devices, and beamed all their lasers at once.
The lasers were being beamed not at the leech's main body, but at the entire body of water.
Immediately, steam rose up from it. The water was evaporating from the ultra-high heat of the lasers.
『Hee, moron! You're a mooorrron!! Is your plan to evaporate the water?! That's pointless! I can replenish as much water as I like from the river!!』
It was as the leech bastard said.
Whatever water was heated up by the lasers and evaporated, it was steadily replenished from the flowing river, and the demonic beast didn't change whatsoever.
Asuka had taken off without the demon leech realizing it, and landed directly in front of it.
「That feels nice♪ There's an amazing updraft when a huge amount of water heats up and evaporates♪」
She kicked up at the sky. At which point, the ascending air swirled around in a vortex, becoming a mini-cyclone and attacking it.
The mini-cyclone swirled around, and spun the demonic beast's water at high speed.
Finally, the leech's real body was flung casually out of it. Asuka immediately dealt it a flying kick.
The leech was slammed against the ground, splattering around disgustingly-coloured bodily fluids.
「Phew. Turning the air generated from the updraft into a cyclone, and separating the bug from the water like a centrifuge, huh?」
「It's a neat idea, but aren't you working us a little hard?」
Even she appeared to be tired, doing the kind of fighting she didn't usually employ.
「Mission, complete...... Artemis, remaining battery low. Entering hibernation.」
Luna, who had continued beaming her lasers, also appeared to be at the limit of her energy.
Saying that, she closed her eyes, then sat down on the spot and stopped moving.
「Looks like she went to sleep. I'll put her back in the container.」
Asuka stooped down to lift Luna into her arms――
But immediately, she spotted something and jumped back.
「Fuuma! It's him! The bug's still alive!」
When I looked at the ground where she shone her light, the half-squashed leech bastard jerked in surprise.
「What tenacity! His insides are spilling out, and he's still alive?!」
『Sh-Shit!! They say even a worm will turn, you asshole!!!』
『“Hey, who's a worm? You'll regret that!!”』
The leech bastard escaped into the grass, while dragging along a trail of internal organs and disgustingly-coloured bodily fluids.
In the mountain night, it was difficult to find a tiny leech that had taken refuge in the grass.
Despite that, figuring that we couldn't afford to let it get away, we were making our eyes bloodshot as we scanned the ground, when
「Looks like everything's taken care of, eh?」
The Masked Madam appeared from the forest.
Though it was still early, she had received Asuka's message that enemy forces had appeared, and come to back us up.
「Madam! Be careful! There's still one around he――」
And then, the Masked Taimanin took a step forward, at which point,
The sound of something being squashed became faintly audible, along with the bug's death cry.

「? Did I step on something?
――......What's the matter with you two?」
She looked back and forth between us, with a puzzled expression.
「Ahaha, is that so? Then, I struck the killing blow, eh? Ah, that's funny.」
When we explained the situation, unusually for her, the Masked Taimanin burst out laughing.
「No, really, he was tough! Tiny enemies are really tricky!」
She was heaving her shoulders, as though her laughter wouldn't subside.
「Ah, I'll just ask this since I ended up seeing her, but...... is that Luna girl a weapon?」
「Not exactly. It's Artemis that's the weapon.」
The Masked Taimanin told me about Luna, surprisingly readily.
A-66 Luna was a semi-artificial life form created to control Artemis.
40% of her body was mechanized, but apart from that, she was no different from a flesh-and-blood human.
However, she spent most of her brain's processing power on controlling Artemis, so her emotions were flat.
「I see...... Then, she's human, in a way. Treating her like she's a weapon part......」
「I have doubts, personally. We're desperate to prevent the spread of Demon World technology, but I do wonder if it's all right to treat people like weapons.」
「That notwithstanding, she's better off now that she's “finished”. Finally, after reaching A-66...... Becoming the 66th, you see.」
Up to this point, 65 of her had been――
When I looked beside me, Asuka had frozen her expression as well. She must not have known that either.
Seeing us like that, the Masked Taimanin suddenly softened her expression.
「Well, still, you did a good job this time.」
「When I decided to request help from Gosha, someone adamantly recommended Fuuma, and that was the right choice.」
Asuka became clearly flustered for some reason.
「You did a good job, figuring out there was a demonic beast hiding in the container! That's why you peeked inside, right?!」
She leaned towards me, making an awkward smile.
「Uh, y-yeah! That's right! Well, I guess you could call it a feeling that comes from experience......」
It appeared that Asuka was under the impression that I had peeked into the container because I noticed the presence of the demonic leech.
（W-Well, I'll keep the truth to myself.）
The Masked Taimanin's knowing smile was scary, though.
After that, the transportation squad caught up with us and safely carried away the weapon Artemis and A-66 Luna――
And the curtain closed on the events of that night.
